scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@mockmatch/api && npm run typecheck --workspace=client && npm run typecheck --workspace=@mockmatch/docs
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=client && npm run build --workspace=@mockmatch/docs
scripts.test:unit: npm run test:unit --workspace=@mockmatch/api && npm run test:unit --workspace=client && npm run test:unit --workspace=@mockmatch/schemas && npm run test:unit --workspace=@mockmatch/ui && npm run test:unit --workspace=@mockmatch/collab && npm run test:unit --workspace=@mockmatch/browser-runner && npm run test:unit --workspace=@mockmatch/voice-agent && npm run test:unit --workspace=@mockmatch/document-editor && npm run test:unit --workspace=@mockmatch/document-assistant && npm run test:unit --workspace=@mockmatch/ide && npm run test:unit --workspace=@mockmatch/whiteboard && npm run test:unit --workspace=@mockmatch/ai-chat && npm run test:unit --workspace=@mockmatch/mcq && npm run test:unit --workspace=@mockmatch/history && npm run test:unit --workspace=@mockmatch/spreadsheet && npm run test:unit --workspace=@mockmatch/page
scripts.test:voice: cd voice && (test -x .venv/bin/python && PYTHONPATH=. .venv/bin/python -m unittest discover -s tests -v || PYTHONPATH=. python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v)

scripts.ci: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test:unit && npm run build && npm run fallow:audit
